name: DST overlap: a start inside the fall-back hour takes the first occurrence
note: America/New_York repeats 01:00 to 01:59 on 2026-11-01, so 01:30 local is ambiguous. RFC 5545 takes the first occurrence, which is still EDT (UTC-4): 05:30Z. The next day, 2026-11-02, is EST (UTC-5), so 01:30 local is 06:30Z. A library that takes the second occurrence (06:30Z on Nov 1) disagrees with this vector.
